name: Meta Muse
tagline: A personal agent with its own secure VM, goals and ideas.
description: Muse is Meta's personal agent app, built on the Muse Spark model from Meta Superintelligence Labs. Each user gets a dedicated cloud computer and browser that keeps working after the app closes, a Goals tab for long plans, an Ideas tab for proactive suggestions, connectors it can write itself, and a permission authority kept apart from the agent and its credentials. Stack inferred from public reporting.
